body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Prevent the predecessor builder from overwriting the active release**

When this historical issue-1744 builder is invoked without `--check` after issue 1745 is active, `main()` still writes all six predecessor documents, including `p1-cumulative-projection.json` and `active-p1-release-manifest.json`, before calling this successor-aware validation. At that point the manifest again reports issue 1744, so this branch is skipped and the command succeeds, leaving the issue-1745 Differentiation release erased and the runtime unable to authenticate it against the new hard-coded hashes. The write path should detect an active successor before modifying the cumulative artifacts, or write only the immutable predecessor files in that situation.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

body: Fixed in `08d9d6c9ac1402f791281a165a4633136e5e8109`. The historical issue-1744 non-`--check` path now inspects the active manifest before any write; when a later active issue is present, it authenticates predecessor custody via `validate_checked_release` and exits without calling the writer. Added `test_non_check_historical_builder_preserves_active_successor`, which binds the active successor bytes and asserts `write_json` is never called. The focused issue-1744 suite passes 11/11, and an actual historical non-`--check` invocation reports that the successor was preserved with no writes.
